Market today: The 30-year Treasury yield hitting a 19-year high is the big driver, pushing up borrowing costs and potentially hurting growth stocks. This is the main concern for your tech/chip-heavy, margin-fueled book.
Your holdings: SOXL is a SELL at -39.74% and needs attention. SPAL is NEW and down -33.08%, also needs attention given its leveraged nature and decay.
Watch: Keep an eye on the Treasury yields and any news that might signal a shift in interest rate expectations.
Bottom line: The rising yield environment is the primary headwind for your concentrated tech holdings.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting this leveraged ETF given its significant loss and the current market headwinds.
SPAL: Monitor this leveraged ETF closely; consider reducing exposure if it continues to decline, especially given margin risk.
